assumptions.emission_pulse_timing: midpoint of each 2-minute interval; each pulse contains its exact interval volume
assumptions.wind: Actual 100 m ERA5; nearest returned location at source; linearly interpolate east/north vectors between hours, fixed weather assignment for each source
assumptions.vertical: Fixed release-height centers with Gaussian spreading and reflective ground; no plume rise
assumptions.boundary: When a puff center exits the ±25 km horizontal square, remove whole puff and account its mass as exited. Infinite Gaussian tails are not clipped. z bounds are display only.
assumptions.initial_condition: Empty at replay start; no upstream or prior-hour puff spinup
assumptions.capture: 90% of newly emitted volume removed at source from installation time; all existing puff masses and trajectories persist
assumptions.numerics: Deterministic analytic Gaussian states; midpoint time integration; no stochastic seed or random particles in scientific data

limitations: Distinct transport-puff-v1 model; does not reproduce or replace annual screening-v1 metrics.
Illustrative transport of a gas-volume proxy, not pollutant concentration, exposure or health risk; no emissions factors.
Diffusivities and 60 m release height are explicit assumptions, not measured or calibrated.
No terrain, building wakes, buoyancy, chemistry, deposition or spatially resolved wind; weather is coarse reanalysis.
Local projected axes approximate true east/north without grid-convergence correction.
Open-boundary removal approximates exit by puff center; Gaussian tails extend outside domain before removal.
Eight-hour, up-to-eight-source subset and selected cell receptor points; not complete regional exposure or community-average estimates.
Puff releases are deterministic 2-minute mass packets; changing this temporal discretization can change near-source curves.

timestep_convergence.note: Linear hourly vector interpolation and midpoint advection are exact away from boundary exit; same source pulses in both runs. Does not test weather uncertainty.

emission_discretization_sensitivity.note: Difference in near-source/time-resolved proxy from finite emission pulses; reported sensitivity, not a calibrated error bound.
